data.name: Britney Britney
data.description:
Britney Britney, or simply Britney, is one of the many secondary characters seen in The Fairly Odd Parents. She's one of the few idols seen in Dimmsdale.

== Appearance ==
Britney is 21 years old, stands at 5'7", and weighs 135 lbs (61 kg). She is of fair skin complexion, has straight, waist-length blonde hair, and pink lipstick for makeup. She has an astonishing hourglass body (wide hips, thick thighs, and waist), D-cup size breasts, and teal eyes. 

She is usually seen wearing her stage outfit, which consists of a long one-sleeved white V-neck crop top, loose white pants with one side snagged against her hipbone, and white platform boots. Her pants have accents that vary from blue to pink depending on the occasion. She also has a microphone attached to her ear while she is on stage in some episodes. Underneath her clothes, she usually wears a white bra as well as matching panties and socks; other times, she wears a lacy pink bra, matching panties with a small bow on them, and thigh-high stockings.

Her alter ego, The Platinum Princess, consists of a platinum colored mechanical armor that can shoot platinum records from a mechanism on the wrist. She wears a platinum mask over her eyes to hide her identity.

== Personality ==
Given the fact that she's a diva, she's very confident in herself, often being assertive in decision-making situations. Despite having a strong will, however, she may not be the smartest diva out there, given her spoiled nature and potential brattiness.

She tends to act like a spoiled celebrity, becoming jealous of those who steal her spotlight or don't pay attention to her. For example, in the season 3 episode "Cosmo Con", she tells an inanimate bar of soap that gets in her eyes that it'll "never work in this town again", presumably referring to Dimmsdale.

In the season 5 episode "The Masked Magician", after the magician Mr. Bickles replaced her Las Vegas show, she vowed revenge and became The Platinum Princess. She attacked Bickles on stage, causing him to decide to just go back to teaching. It is presumed that she returned to her normal pop career after this one incident.

== Trivia ==
- Her appearance, as well as her name, is an allusion to Britney Spears.
- She is a pop diva who has been a celebrity since she was a fetus.
- She is well known and loved amongst both kids and adults alike. 
- Some of her concerts have a "No Kids" policy, although this did not stop the popular kids Tad and Chad from attending.
- Francis, Timmy Turner's longtime bully, is also said to secretly be a big fan of her.
- She's voiced by Tara Strong, the same voice actress who voiced Timmy Turner himself.
- Sometimes, when performing on stage, she's accompanied by her backup dancers.
- In the season 3 episode "Cosmo Con", after "hitting it" and consequently getting kicked out of the Turners' house by Mrs. Turner, Britney angrily told herself she would do no more private gigs.
